headline: DLR Q2 FFO Beats on Leasing Strength & Renewal Rent, '26 View Raised
summary: Digital Realty tops Q2 estimates as a record backlog, strong bookings and higher renewal rents drive growth, prompting a higher 2026 core FFO outlook.

headline: Unlocking Q2 Potential of Ventas (VTR): Exploring Wall Street Estimates for Key Metrics
summary: Looking beyond Wall Street's top-and-bottom-line estimate forecasts for Ventas (VTR), delve into some of its key metrics to gain a deeper insight into the company's potential performance for the quarter ended June 2026.
